en.text:
Grants an Additional Melee Charge.

Using your Charged Melee Ability while sliding performs a <stasis/>Stasis Uppercut, dealing damage and <stasis/><pve freezing /> <pvp [slowing] /> targets within ? meters of the attack. 

Howl of The Storm instantly spawns two lines of <stasis/>Stasis Crystals in a (V) Formation in front of you. Each line is comprised of one small, two medium, then one large <stasis/>Stasis Crystal.

Spawned <stasis/>Crystals are considered Powered Melees and inherent damage boosts, melee effects, and Exotic benefits.

This attack can also be used during <stasis/>Glacial Quake at the cost of 15% Super Energy per Uppercut.

Firing your weapon during the slide disables this ability.
